blocks.source: 全世界を駆け巡るという物語ではなく、一つの国を中心に展開する。元々、帝国に属していた主人公は反乱軍を率いて帝国を倒すことになる。ＲＰＧというよりは、ＳＲＰＧによくありそうな王道ストーリー。（システム的にもＳＲＰＧ的な要素が多々あり。）
blocks.translation: Rather than a story spanning the entire world, the game focuses on a single country. The protagonist, who originally belonged to the Empire, eventually leads a rebel army to overthrow it. It is a classic story more commonly found in a SRPG than an RPG. (The game system also contains numerous SRPG-like elements.)

blocks.source: ただ「帝国将軍の息子である主人公がなぜ反乱軍に身を投じるのか？」という動機付けは少し弱い気がする。この作品の主人公は喋らないタイプなので、それだけの大きな決断を下すにも関わらず、内面描写がされないわけで。帝国側でも、主人公の父を始めとした何人かは立派な人物として描写されており、それを裏切るのだからなおさら。僕なんかは「帝国内部から変えた方が現実的で良くね？」と思ってしまった。
blocks.translation: However, I feel that the motivation behind “Why does the protagonist, the son of an Imperial general, join the rebellion?” is somewhat weak. The protagonist in this game is the silent type, so despite making such a momentous decision, we never get any insight into his inner thoughts. This is even more problematic because several people on the Imperial side, including the protagonist’s father, are portrayed as admirable individuals, and he is betraying them. I found myself thinking, “Wouldn’t it be more realistic—and better—to change things from within the Empire?”

blocks.source: ラストバトルは結構あっさり。物語の黒幕である人物とは戦わずに終わるので「こいつがラスボスでいいの？」と思ったプレイヤーは多数だと思われる。これはこれで、逆に意外だったけれど……。一応、物語としてはきちんと片が付いている。
blocks.translation: The final battle is over fairly quickly. Since the game ends without fighting the person behind the story’s schemes, many players probably wondered, “Is this really the final boss?” It was surprising in its own way, though.... At least the story is wrapped up properly.

blocks.source: このシリーズの特徴は水滸伝にちなんで仲間が１０８人もいること。しかし、どうしても数が多すぎて人物の個性が弱くなってしまう。数合わせ程度の意味しかないキャラクターや、その登場のための薄いイベントが多くなるのは悲しいところ。
blocks.translation: A defining feature of this series is that, following the example of Water Margin, it has 108 companions. However, there are inevitably too many characters, which weakens their individuality. It is unfortunate that there are so many characters whose only purpose is to fill out the numbers, along with shallow events designed merely to introduce them.

blocks.source: ベストエンディングを見るための条件は難解で、攻略情報を見ないとまず無理ゲー。
blocks.translation: The requirements for seeing the best ending are obscure, making it practically impossible without a walkthrough.

blocks.source: 戦闘システムはオーソドックスなターン制。戦闘参加人数が６人と多め。仲間の組み合わせによっては協力攻撃を使える。強い個性や高い完成度はないが、無難な作り。
blocks.translation: The battle system is a conventional turn-based one. The number of participants is fairly high at six. Depending on the combination of companions, you can use cooperative attacks. It lacks strong individuality or exceptional polish, but it is solidly made.

blocks.source: たまにイベントで軍隊同士の戦闘があるけれど、システム的には単なるジャンケンに毛が生えたレベル。とはいえ、幻想水滸伝２ではこれがかなり鬱陶しい物になるので、それよりははるかにマシなはず。
blocks.translation: There are occasional event battles between armies, but from a system standpoint, they are little more than rock-paper-scissors. That said, they become quite irritating in Suikoden II, so this version should be far more tolerable.

blocks.source: 敵と比較してレベルが低いキャラは一気にレベルが上がるように調整されているので、途中参加の新キャラクターも使いやすい。……がしかし、ストーリー上の都合で、パーティ編成が固定されることが多い。特にラストダンジョン・ラストバトルのメンバーの３／６が固定されてしまう。自由に編成したかった。
blocks.translation: Characters whose levels are low compared to the enemies are adjusted to gain levels rapidly, making new characters who join partway through the game easy to use. However, party composition is often fixed for story reasons. In particular, three of the six members for the final dungeon and final battle are locked in place. I wanted to be able to arrange the party freely.

blocks.source: キャラクターごとの能力的な個性もそれほど強くないため、結局、シナリオと関わりが深いキャラを中心に編成しがちになりやすい。
blocks.translation: Since the characters do not differ all that much in terms of abilities, you ultimately tend to build your party around characters who are closely involved in the scenario.

blocks.source: 難易度はやや低め。数ヶ所だけ難しいところがあったが、最後までほとんど全滅することもないはず。
blocks.translation: The difficulty is somewhat low. There are only a few difficult sections, and you should rarely suffer a total party wipe before the end.

blocks.source: 通常攻撃のテンポがかなり速い。「おまかせ」にすると更に早くなって快適。ただし、紋章術・協力技などの戦闘アニメは長め。
blocks.translation: The pace of normal attacks is quite fast. Turning on “Auto-Battle” makes it even faster and more comfortable. However, battle animations for rune magic and cooperative techniques are rather long.

blocks.source: 仲間が１０８人もいるので、集めるためのサブイベントは手間。また、メインイベント自体のフラグ立ても面倒で、次にどこに行けばいいのかわからないことも。
blocks.translation: With 108 companions to recruit, the side events required to gather them are tedious. In addition, triggering the main events themselves can be a hassle, and there are times when you do not know where to go next.

blocks.source: 全般的にインターフェースはもっさり気味。特にパーティ編成は頻度が多いだけに気になる。ロード時間もやや長め。
blocks.translation: The interface feels sluggish overall. Party formation is especially noticeable because you do it so frequently. Loading times are also somewhat long.

blocks.source: グラフィックは２Ｄメイン。この時期、多かった３Ｄの粗いポリゴンを見せられるよりは全然良い。ただし、キャラクターの顔グラは微妙な感じ。戦闘背景や術のエフェクトは３Ｄで処理しており、中々派手にできている。
blocks.translation: The graphics are primarily 2D. For this period, this is much better than being subjected to the crude 3D polygons that were so common. However, the character portraits are underwhelming. The battle backgrounds and spell effects are rendered in 3D and are quite flashy.

blocks.source: 質は低くないが、これといって目立つ曲もなし。特にボス戦曲が１つしかなく、序盤の中ボスからラスボス戦まで、全部同じ曲。ファミコンじゃあるまいし、ＰＳのゲームでこれはちょっと悲しい。激戦区と言えるほど、クオリティの高い曲があふれたＲＰＧ界の中では印象が薄い部類かも。
blocks.translation: The quality is not poor, but there are no particularly memorable tracks. In particular, there is only one boss battle theme, used for everything from the mid-boss early in the game to the final boss. This is not an NES game, so seeing this in a PlayStation game is rather disappointing. In the RPG genre, a highly competitive field overflowing with high-quality music, it may be one of the less memorable soundtracks.
